title: KUBRA KO AJAB RAAT YEH KHISMAT NE DIKHAYI
body:
KUBRA KO AJAB RAAT YEH KHISMAT NE DIKHAYI
Kubra Ko Ajab Raat Yeh Khismat Ne Dikhayi Kal Hoyengi Bewa
Kangna Bhi Bhadha Haath Me Mehandi Bhi Lagayi Kal Hoyengi Bewa
1.Nousha Bhi Shehzada Dulhan Bhi Hai Khuzadi Kya Khoob Hai Shadi
Wo Ibne Hasan Aur Yeh Shabbir Ki Jaayi Kal Hoyengi Bewa
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Ek Shab Se Ziyada Na Rahengi Yeh Suhagan Takhdeer Hai Dushman
Lootege Aadu Zouja e Shabbar Ki Kamai Kal Hoyengi Bewa
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Pamaal Karinge Tan-e-Nousha Ko Aada Looth Jayenga Sehra
Tar Khoon Me Hojayangi Yeh Dast e Hinayi Kal Hoyengi Bewa
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Ghunghat Me Dulhan Rorahi Hai Sar Ko Jukaye Chehre Ko Chupaye
Maa Phupiyun Se Sharmati Hai Gardu Ki Satayi Kal Hoyengi Bewa
